# API reference (v0.1.0)

Interactive docs: `/docs` (Swagger UI). Machine-readable spec: [`openapi.json`](openapi.json).

E-commerce backend with a conversational assistant. Every response uses the envelope `{ success, data, meta }` or `{ success: false, error: { code, message, details?, requestId } }`.

| Method | Path | Auth | Parameters | Body | Success | Summary |
| ------ | ---- | ---- | ---------- | ---- | ------- | ------- |
| GET | `/health` | — | — | — | 200 | Liveness + readiness: 200 when the API and its database are reachable, 503 otherwise. |
| GET | `/api/v1/products` | — | `q`, `category`, `minPriceCents`, `maxPriceCents`, `inStock`, `page`, `pageSize` | — | 200 | Search and filter the active catalog. |
| GET | `/api/v1/products/categories` | — | — | — | 200 | Distinct categories of active products. |
| GET | `/api/v1/products/{id}` | — | `id` | — | 200 | A single active product. |
| POST | `/api/v1/admin/products` | admin key | — | `CreateProductDto` | 201 | Creates a product. |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/admin/products/{id}` | admin key | `id` | `UpdateProductDto` | 200 | Partial update. Stock is adjusted only via a relative `stockDelta`. |
| GET | `/api/v1/orders` | bearer | `page`, `pageSize` | — | 200 | The caller's orders, newest first. |
| POST | `/api/v1/orders` | bearer | — | `CreateOrderDto` | 201 | Places an order. Prices and totals are resolved server-side. |
| GET | `/api/v1/orders/{id}` | bearer | `id` | — | 200 | One of the caller's orders (404 for anyone else's). |
| GET | `/api/v1/me` | bearer | — | — | 200 | The authenticated customer. |
